checks.name: quiet-control
checks.command: cargo test --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-body --test behavior_contract quiet_is_the_same_on_the_compact_body -- --exact

findings: The test-only adapter composes the existing body-owned motor and sensor attachment helpers, preserves neutral port mappings, and contains no expected behavior or learning oracle.
The compact body passes quiet identity and the distant no-action control. The full shared execution reports 2 passing test groups and 4 failing test groups.

Local formation is the first mismatch: the compact body emits no outward effect where the old oracle emits one effect at tick 2. Learning and checkpoint scenarios therefore fail at that same initial transition.

The adapter mismatch agrees with the independent existing body law a_local_surface_forms_one_reusable_choice_without_duplicate_growth, which also observes no action. This localizes the result to body behavior rather than adapter projection.
Among six deterministic variants, the distance-four negative control passes and all five action-producing variants fail with the same absent effect.
residual_uncertainty: Later consequence retention and checkpoint continuation cannot yet be compared because compact-body execution fails at the preceding local-action formation transition.
The shared incidence label maps to an ordinary caused Arrival because the compact body derives transitions from junction retention instead of accepting incidence as boundary metadata.
Behavioral equivalence with the old organism is refuted for the current catalog even though the adapter implementation itself is supported.
